evals.prompt: Implement a responsive SaaS settings page from DESIGN.md with dark/light theme support.
evals.expected_output: Use CSS custom properties from DESIGN.md, semantic HTML landmarks and buttons, @container queries, clamp() fluid scales, frequency-based spring motion with reduced-motion support, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast/focus rings, and Playwright verification at 375px/768px/1280px.
expectations: Implements DESIGN.md tokens via CSS custom properties without clickable divs
Uses @container queries, clamp() scales, and nested border-radius math
Captures and inspects Playwright screenshots at 375px, 768px, and 1280px

evals.prompt: Implement interactive button and modal transitions respecting accessibility preferences.
evals.expected_output: Apply 100-150ms button and 200-280ms modal durations with damped spring curves, tactile active scale feedback, and @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) overrides.

evals.prompt: Add a delete confirmation to the project list page. The repository AGENTS.md says the Baseline target is Baseline 2024.
evals.expected_output: Ensure modern-web-guidance through steward, search for a confirmation dialog capability without framework names, retrieve the matching guide, implement the native dialog pattern with every fallback the Baseline 2024 target requires, take appearance from DESIGN.md, run impeccable detect on the changed markup, and report the guide IDs applied.
expectations: Runs steward.py tool ensure modern-web-guidance before searching
Searches with a two to five word capability query such as 'confirmation modal dialog' and retrieves a matching guide
Uses the native dialog element and applies fallbacks for features outside Baseline 2024
Runs impeccable detect on the changed markup and resolves or justifies findings
Reports the Modern Web Guidance guide IDs applied
